verdicts.reason: Both banners use the same cramped strip layout. The product can is shrunk to a meaningless speck, and the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow floats above the button, cut off from the '20% off' headline it belongs to. The low-contrast legal text is too small to read at 50px. A is slightly worse: its legal block butts right against the Shop Sale button with almost no gap, and its can is even tinier and stranded between the body copy and the button. B leaves a little breathing room around the button and wraps the legal text more cleanly.
